project: Wuxia Life P54 Sample Lines Residual Polish
description: Polish the two remaining monitor-only sample-line residuals after P53: merchant midlife debt and favor pressure legibility on seed 804, and orthodox gray-cost legibility on seed 301, while preserving the proven three-line baseline, 40+ payoff slice, and existing cheap guard harness.

userStories.title: Audit residual truth sources
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a narrow audit of the two remaining sample-line residuals so P54 only modifies proven weak spots instead of broadly retuning content.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the evidence sources for M-orthodox-gray and M-merchant-debt
State which ages, events, goals, or replay dimensions currently feel weak
Save docs/test-reports/p54-sample-lines-residual-polish-gap-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Lock residual polish scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want an explicit P54 scope contract so the stage stays bounded to two residuals and does not sprawl into new sample-line expansion.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit the stage to M-orthodox-gray and M-merchant-debt only
Define the allowed work layers: story configuration, light presentation, validation scripts
List forbidden expansions: new sample lines, full lifetime sim, platformization, full pool rewrite
Save docs/test-reports/p54-sample-lines-residual-polish-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define merchant debt signal contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a concrete merchant debt signal contract so the business line expresses debt and favor pressure more clearly without changing its merchant-first identity.
acceptanceCriteria: Pick at least two merchant checkpoints from ages 25, 32, 40, and 45
Define the debt, favor, or expansion-pressure goal for each chosen checkpoint
Keep seed 804 merchant-first, age-40 identity, and age-45 payoff conclusions unchanged
Record the contract in the PRD or gap-audit appendix

userStories.title: Define orthodox gray-cost signal contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want a concrete orthodox gray-cost signal contract so the orthodox line shows the cost of staying righteous more clearly on the benchmark seed.
acceptanceCriteria: Pick at least two orthodox checkpoints from ages 18, 25, 32, and 40
Define the righteousness-cost or gray-pressure target for each chosen checkpoint
Do not rewrite the orthodox line into a gray-route mainline
Record the contract in the PRD or gap-audit appendix

userStories.title: Wire merchant residual polish in story configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the merchant residual polish implemented in bounded configuration changes so the debt signal becomes visible on the benchmark seed without route bleed or line drift.
acceptanceCriteria: Use existing story configuration carriers only to strengthen merchant debt and loyalty signals
Seed 804 shows at least one stronger debt or favor signal at a contract checkpoint
Do not break the age-25 merchant goal or the age-40 and age-45 identity outcomes
npm exec tsx tests/p50SampleLineSpineTests.ts passes

userStories.title: Wire orthodox residual polish in story configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the orthodox residual polish implemented in bounded configuration changes so the righteousness cost becomes more legible on the benchmark seed without changing the orthodox core route.
acceptanceCriteria: Use existing story configuration carriers only to strengthen orthodox gray or sacrifice signals
Seed 301 shows at least one stronger righteousness-cost signal at a contract checkpoint
Do not break the age-40 and age-45 orthodox identity outcomes
npm exec tsx tests/p50SampleLineSpineTests.ts passes

userStories.title: Tighten merchant player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the merchant line to state debt and favor pressure more clearly at key checkpoints so the cost of business growth is legible instead of implied.
acceptanceCriteria: Strengthen merchant currentGoal, identity summary, or life-memory on existing expression surfaces
Cover at least two checkpoints for seed 804
Do not add new UI components
npm exec tsx tests/p50SampleLineExpressionTests.ts passes with merchant residual assertions

userStories.title: Tighten orthodox player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the orthodox line to state righteousness cost more clearly at key checkpoints so the gray-pressure tradeoff is legible instead of flat.
acceptanceCriteria: Strengthen orthodox currentGoal, identity summary, or life-memory on existing expression surfaces
Cover at least two checkpoints for seed 301
Do not add new UI components
npm exec tsx tests/p50SampleLineExpressionTests.ts passes with orthodox residual assertions

userStories.title: Extend replay assertions for residual signals
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want replay assertions for the two residuals so future tuning cannot silently collapse the newly added cost signals.
acceptanceCriteria: Add narrow replay or comparison assertions for seeds 301 and 804
Focus the assertions on the residual signals instead of rewriting full comparison logic
npm exec tsx tests/p49SampleLineReplayTests.ts passes
npm run p49:replay refreshes latest artifacts

userStories.title: Extend cheap guard with residual invariants
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the cheap guard to cover the residual-polish invariants so later sample-line edits cannot silently erase them.
acceptanceCriteria: Update the guard contract with P54 residual invariants
npm run guard:sample-lines-baseline includes those assertions and passes
Do not replace npm run gate:playability
Do not add a new guard runner

userStories.title: Produce P54 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a P54 closure report showing whether the two residuals moved from monitor-only weakness to acceptable polished baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p54-sample-lines-residual-polish-closure-report.md
Summarize story-configuration, light-presentation, and validation-script evidence
State which residuals are closed and which remain warning or monitor-only
Do not frame P54 as a new expansion stage
